BiblicalUsage: Fat is the rich part of the sacrifice and the pasture, and the word is used for both: David offers burnt sacrifices of fatlings with the incense of rams, and Isaiah says the lambs shall feed in the fat pastures of the waste places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fat is the Bible's picture of the best portion: God is given the richest part, and the flock feeds where the land is fat — because the LORD provides the best for His own.
